subject: Operations
title: Demand Planning
description: Learn Demand Planning in one minute.

hook.text: A toy company expected moderate holiday sales. The toy went viral. Shelves emptied in hours. Demand planning failed.

buildup.text: Demand planning estimates future customer demand so companies can prepare supply, capacity, and inventory.

discovery.text: It combines historical data, market trends, promotions, and expert judgment into a consensus forecast.

twist.text: Forecasts are always wrong—the goal isn't perfection but reducing error and planning for the range of outcomes.

climax.text: S&OP meetings align sales, marketing, and operations around one demand plan. One number, one plan, one team.

punchline.text: Plan for demand, then plan for being wrong.

quiz.question: What is the goal of demand planning?
options: Reducing forecast error and preparing supply
